topics.title: Write a paragraph about your future school.
guiding_questions: What should your future school be designed with?
How can students surf the net?
What will teachers and students do in laboratories?
What should planners and designers put as their major concern?
topics.sample_essay: My future school should be designed with much care on health and well-being. Students can easily surf the net from 3D screens. In their laboratories, teachers and students will be engaged in virtual reality screens and discuss different topics. Exams can be done electronically. Planners and designers should put safety as their major concern.

topics.title: Write a paragraph about your first day at school.
guiding_questions: How did you feel on your first day at school?
What did you see at school?
How did you feel after your parents left?
Did you like school after some time? Why?
topics.sample_essay: My first day at school was a memorable experience. I felt excited but also a little nervous. My mother accompanied me to school. I saw a big building with many classrooms and a playground. When my mother left, I felt sad and started crying. But soon I made new friends and began to love my school. Now I enjoy going to school every day.
